scope: Embedded local automation scheduling primitive; the Mortise host, protocol, store, history, idempotency, and delivery authority remain product-owned hard constraints.
hardConstraints: No second scheduler, store, history, or dispatcher
Works inside the existing host-owned SQLite transaction boundary
Does not reinterpret Session or Agent Loop semantics
selectionRule: Reuse the highest-ranked candidate only for cron occurrence calculation. Reject any candidate topology that becomes a scheduler, store, worker lifecycle, or delivery authority.
discoveryStop: Stopped after three maintained TypeScript/JavaScript in-process scheduling candidates with clear licenses and public release history; service-backed workflow engines were excluded by the no-external-service hard constraint.
